sources.title: A Modigliana inaugurato il nuovo ponte di Ca' Stronchino
Alluvione Emilia Romagna, il ponte di Ca' Stronchino ancora come un anno fa

curation_note.it: La stazione di Modigliana è sul Marzeno e dista circa 1,8 km dal punto ARCUS. Il rapporto validato registra 3,07 m s.z.i. il 16 maggio contro la soglia 3 di 1,00 m. La data ARCUS del 19 maggio coincide con la documentazione pubblica immediatamente successiva; la misura viene quindi mostrata come contesto della piena 16-18 maggio, non come livello alla sezione del ponte nell’istante del collasso.
curation_note.en: The Modigliana gauge is on the Marzeno about 1.8 km from the ARCUS point. The validated report records 3.07 m above the local gauge datum on 16 May against a 1.00 m threshold 3. The 19 May ARCUS date aligns with immediate post-event reporting; the measurement is therefore shown as context for the 16-18 May flood, not as the bridge-section stage at the instant of collapse.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official validated event report, ARPAE station registry and official reconstruction record

caveats: Stage values are relative to the Modigliana gauge datum and are not water depth or absolute elevation.
The gauge is approximately 1.8 km from the ARCUS bridge point; its stage is not transferred to the bridge section.
The validated peak was recorded on 16 May within the documented 16-18 May damage window, while the controlled ARCUS record is dated 19 May.
No discharge is assigned because no validated event-specific stage-discharge conversion is used here.
Hydrometric loading context and the documented bridge failure process remain separate evidence classes.
